question.text: The <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>pH</mi></math> at which <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Mg</mi><mo>(</mo><mi>OH</mi><msub><mo>)</mo><mn>2</mn></msub><mfenced close="]" open="["><mrow><mo> </mo><msub><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi><mi>sp</mi></msub><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>11</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></math> begins to precipitate from a solution containing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>0</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>10</mn><mi mathvariant="normal">M</mi></math> <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>Mg</mi><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup></math> ions is ______.

solution.text:
Precipitation when Q=Ksp

Q=Reaction quotient, it is the ratio of products to reactants at any time of reaction.

Ksp=Solubility product.

MgOH2⇋Mg2++2OH-

Mg2+OH-2=10-11

0.1×OH-2=10-11⇒OH-=10-5

⇒pOH=5  ⇒pH=14-5=9
